svg.title: Autoscaling
svg.desc: Autoscaling. Add and remove instances automatically as load rises and falls. Step 1, Steady state: Two instances run at about 50% CPU, under the 60% target. The autoscaler holds at the minimum of 2. Step 2, Spike: scale out: Traffic doubles and CPU hits 96%. Two new instances boot and join once they pass health checks. Step 3, New capacity: Four instances at about 50%, latency back to normal. The scale-in window ignores a brief dip. Step 4, Scale in: Load falls. After the scale-in window, two instances drain their connections and are terminated.

g.text: Two instances run at about 50% CPU, under the 60% target. The autoscaler holds at the minimum of 2.
Traffic doubles and CPU hits 96%. Two new instances boot and join once they pass health checks.
Four instances at about 50%, latency back to normal. The scale-in window ignores a brief dip.
Load falls. After the scale-in window, two instances drain their connections and are terminated.
desired = instances × CPU ÷ target, rounded up
under target: wait out the window
low for the whole window: remove 2
scale out quickly when CPU is over target
scale in only after 5 min of low load
